assertions.assertion: Explains the library registers IConfigureNamedOptions<OpenIdConnectOptions> wrapping OnRedirectToIdentityProvider, OnAuthorizationCodeReceived, OnTokenValidated and OnPushAuthorization
assertions.rationale: Doesn't state the IConfigureNamedOptions wrapping or list all four events; mentions only OnAuthorizationCodeReceived/OnRedirectToIdentityProvider.

assertions.assertion: States assigning new event handlers/OpenIdConnectEvents replaces the DPoP handlers; capture the existing handler and invoke it from yours
assertions.rationale: States assigning new OpenIdConnectEvents replaces the library's handlers; shows capturing 'previous' and calling it.

assertions.assertion: States OpenIdConnectOptions.EventsType must not be used because it silently removes all library handlers

With PAR, signs the request in OnPushAuthorization before invoking the library handler (so dpop_jkt is included in the signed request and the client assertion is added afterwards); without PAR signs in OnRedirectToIdentityProvider after the library handler
assertions.rationale: Calls the original handler first in OnRedirectToIdentityProvider and says to call original first in OnPushAuthorization, reversing the required sign-before-library order for PAR.

assertions.assertion: Notes the library adds the client assertion from IClientAssertionService to the code exchange and, on .NET 9+, the PAR request, but does not create JAR request objects
assertions.rationale: Doesn't state the library adds client assertions to code exchange/PAR or that it doesn't create JAR objects.
